name: armario-do-diogo
description: Armario do Diogo - lista de prendas e inventario do baby shower

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run verificar && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
